trigger.description: A foreground mesh export includes secret-shaped material in body, tag, evidence/artifact path, embedding surrogate, or policy JSON fields.
setup_commands: insert a mesh import-ledger event whose eventJson contains API_KEY=<sentinel>, tags, evidenceRefs[].artifactPath=keys/id_ed25519, and embeddingSurrogate=<sentinel>

expected_emission.repair_string: Redact or remove the flagged body, tag, evidence, artifact path, embedding surrogate, or policy JSON before retrying export.
